headline: US Refineries Shift Production Toward Distillate Fuels and Jet Fuel
summary: US refineries have reduced gasoline yields in 2026 to prioritize the production of distillate fuel oil and jet fuel. This shift is driven by higher refinery margins for these middle distillates compared to gasoline.
why: Refinery yield adjustments are key indicators of energy market supply dynamics and profitability for integrated oil and gas companies.
why_moved: The shift in refinery output alters the supply balance for refined petroleum products, directly impacting the availability and pricing of gasoline and middle distillates in the US market.
